verdict_meanings.FABRICATED: path 404s, never archived, and >=5 sibling pages in the same section/month ARE archived
verdict_meanings.EXISTS: the archive holds a capture of this exact path
verdict_meanings.LIVE: the path answers with something other than 404/410
verdict_meanings.WEAK_CONTROL: path 404s and is unarchived, but the control has <5 siblings — suggestive, NOT proven
verdict_meanings.INCONCLUSIVE: no sibling coverage at all for that control, so absence proves nothing
verdict_meanings.NO_ANSWER: nothing answered, curl included — invented-host territory, not this defect
